landing.frameworkTitle: The Premium Foundation for Exceptional Products
landing.frameworkDescription: Skip the boilerplate and start building. Sonae provides a highly polished, high-performance canvas that lets you launch beautiful, secure, and scalable applications in a fraction of the time.

dashboard.intro: Sonae is a complete foundation for building serious AI products. It already includes the things customers ask for after the first demo: model choice, private knowledge, safer AI behaviour, AI process building, cost control, usage visibility, customer widgets, and a large safety net of automated checks.

hero.title: Start with the platform depth serious AI buyers expect.
hero.body: Most AI products begin with a chat box, then spend months adding the essentials: trusted model choices, protection from prompt attacks, private company knowledge, clear user permissions, a record of what AI has done, AI flow builders, usage limits, and cost reporting. Sonae brings those foundations together from day one, so you can build the unique product on top.

answers.label: Google Gemini, ChatGPT, Fable, Claude Opus, Claude Haiku, Claude Sonnet, and room for approved model choices

knowledge.label: company knowledge, file uploads, sensitive information handling, and clear access rules

control.label: protection against prompt attacks, jailbreak attempts, unsafe actions, data leaks, and cross-company access

growth.label: visibility by model, customer, user, message volume, usage limits, and running spend

assistant.title: Choice of leading AI models
assistant.body: Sonae lets you offer the right model for the right job, including Google Gemini, ChatGPT, Fable, Claude Opus, Claude Haiku, and Claude Sonnet, all from one managed product experience.

knowledge.title: Private knowledge for each customer
knowledge.body: Documents, uploaded files, company guidance, and AI knowledge can be kept inside the right customer workspace, so teams can use business context without mixing data between companies.

workflows.title: Visual AI flow builder
workflows.body: Create multi-step AI journeys, scheduled work, approvals, follow-ups, and repeatable flows. This lets products move beyond simple chat into AI that can actually help work get done.

widget.title: Protection from AI misuse
widget.body: Sonae is built with safeguards for prompt manipulation, jailbreak attempts, unsafe actions, sensitive data exposure, and attempts to make the AI ignore rules or access the wrong company.

reports.title: Clear view of what AI is doing
reports.body: Teams can review conversations, actions taken, completed flows, failed steps, customer chats, and health signals, so the business is not guessing what happened.

admin.title: Cost and usage control
admin.body: Sonae shows usage across models, customers, users, messages, and running costs, giving teams the visibility needed to price, manage, and scale AI responsibly.

platformDepth.title: The hard platform pieces are already there.
platformDepth.body: The value is not only the assistant people can see. The real advantage is the control, safety, visibility, and management layer behind it.

models.title: Approved model catalogue
models.body: Offer multiple model families while keeping choices clear, controlled, and aligned to cost, quality, and customer needs.

safety.title: Defence against AI attacks
safety.body: Built-in protections help defend against hostile prompts, rule bypasses, unsafe AI actions, and attempts to extract restricted information.

privacy.title: Sensitive data handled with care
privacy.body: Knowledge, documents, users, chats, and company data are organised around clear separation, so each customer only reaches what they should.

testing.title: 700+ automated checks
testing.body: The product is protected by a large set of automated checks across sign-in, users, customers, AI agents, flows, model choice, safety, knowledge, reporting, widgets, and management screens.

observability.title: AI activity visibility
observability.body: Review what AI did, which flows ran, what actions were taken, where failures happened, and what customers experienced.

costs.title: Spend visibility and limits
costs.body: Track usage, messages, model costs, company activity, top users, plans, and monthly limits before spend gets out of hand.

workflows.title: AI flow builder
workflows.body: Create repeatable AI processes, schedule work, review results, and turn product-specific know-how into reusable flows.

widgets.title: Customer-facing AI widgets
widgets.body: Deploy branded AI assistants into websites or portals and test them safely before customers use them.

hosting.title: Deploy Sonae where your customers need it.
hosting.body: Sonae can be shaped around the hosting choice that best fits the customer, procurement process, security expectations, and existing cloud relationship.

googleCloud.title: Google Cloud
googleCloud.body: Run Sonae on Google Cloud for customers already invested in Google's AI, data, and enterprise cloud services.

aws.title: AWS
aws.body: Deploy on AWS for organisations that want Sonae inside their established Amazon cloud environment, account structure, and operating model.

azure.title: Azure
azure.body: Support Microsoft-first customers with an Azure deployment path that fits existing enterprise cloud, identity, and management expectations.

assurance.title: A serious AI platform needs proof it will keep working.
assurance.body: Sonae is backed by more than 700 automated checks across product behaviour, security scenarios, user screens, AI safety, flows, model handling, reporting, widgets, and protection against old problems returning. That matters because AI products can fail quietly: permissions can change, actions can reach too far, prompts can be attacked, costs can rise, and customer journeys can break.
assurance.proofBody: The checks cover the customer experience, management screens, company separation, AI model behaviour, knowledge handling, AI flows, cost reporting, widgets, and the rules that stop old problems from returning.

unit.title: Everyday product rules
unit.body: Small but important product rules are checked automatically, so everyday changes are less likely to break shared behaviour.

security.title: Security and access checks
security.body: Automated checks cover company boundaries, role permissions, invite access, file uploads, unsafe AI flow behaviour, and AI safety rules.

ui.title: Screen and journey checks
ui.body: Important screens such as dashboards, management tables, modals, settings, users, companies, AI flows, costs, widgets, and assistant controls are checked as real product experiences.

regression.title: Old-problem protection
regression.body: Automated rules help stop old mistakes from returning, including broken page patterns, unsafe shortcuts, inconsistent lists, and accidental changes to protected demo areas.

backend.title: AI and data checks
backend.body: AI agents, activity history, reporting, chat, companies, knowledge, flows, schedules, model choices, approved actions, and health signals are checked behind the scenes.

drift.title: Growth and maintenance checks
drift.body: Checks protect the patterns that keep the platform manageable as more companies, users, chats, models, AI flows, and widgets are added.

benefits.title: Start beyond the prototype stage.
benefits.body: When a customer asks about safety, privacy, model choice, visibility, costs, team permissions, reliability, or scale, Sonae already has a credible answer. That is why it is a foundation for building AI products, not just another interface.

faster.title: Months of foundation work already done
faster.body: Sign-in, roles, customer workspaces, management pages, model choices, chat, files, knowledge, approved actions, widgets, AI flows, reporting, and settings already exist as product surfaces.

safer.title: Built for enterprise questions
safer.body: The platform can answer buyer questions about sensitive information, AI misuse, company separation, manager oversight, activity history, role boundaries, and controlled model use.

clearer.title: Prove reliability with checks
clearer.body: A broad set of automated checks protects the core product: AI safety, AI flows, sign-in, knowledge, reporting, management journeys, and widgets.

together.title: Sell a complete platform story
together.body: Sonae lets you show buyers the full picture: polished user experience, controlled AI, clear oversight, cost control, room to extend, and a real product base.

governance.title: The management layer is built for running AI in the real world.
governance.body: Sonae gives teams the controls needed after the first demo succeeds: who can access what, which models can run, what AI did, which actions were taken, how much each customer costs, and whether the platform is healthy.

tenancy.title: Customer workspace separation
tenancy.body: Companies, users, knowledge, widgets, chat history, model settings, rules, and permissions are shaped around separate customer workspaces rather than one shared space.

roles.title: Clear roles and permissions
roles.body: Platform owners, company managers, and everyday users can have different screens and permissions, making it possible to sell Sonae-backed products into multi-company environments.

pii.title: Sensitive information handling
pii.body: Careful language, file rules, access controls, and private knowledge areas give the product a stronger answer when buyers ask how sensitive information is handled.

tools.title: Controlled AI actions
tools.body: AI actions are not left open-ended. They are configured, permissioned, checked, recorded, and only run through approved paths.

audit.title: Clear activity history
audit.body: Teams can inspect setting changes, chat history, AI activity, completed flows, failed actions, and operational events instead of guessing what happened.

health.title: Platform health and maintenance
health.body: Health checks, maintenance tools, alerts, cleanup routines, reporting snapshots, and diagnostics help support the platform after launch.

useCases.title: This is the foundation underneath an AI business.

sales.title: For SaaS and customer portals
sales.body: Build customer-facing AI with branded widgets, approved knowledge, safe model access, support flows, and management visibility from the same base.

customers.title: For internal AI workspaces
customers.body: Give teams a controlled assistant with files, knowledge, model choice, reports, team access, chat history, and organisation-level controls.

teams.title: For AI work automation products
teams.body: Use Sonae's AI flow builder, schedules, activity history, approved actions, safety layer, and visibility to build products that do work, not just answer questions.

modal.title: Why Sonae is a stronger starting point
modal.body: Sonae already brings together the hard enterprise pieces: model choice across leading AI families, safer private knowledge, protection from prompt attacks, AI flow building, clear activity history, automated checks, cost control, customer workspaces, widgets, and management controls.
modal.pointBody: Build the unique product layer on top of Sonae instead of spending months recreating the foundation every serious AI buyer will expect you to have.
